question: Sonu Nigam was awarded the Padma Shri in 2022 for which of the following fields?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Art**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Sonu Nigam is a renowned Indian playback singer, live performer, composer, and actor who has sung in multiple languages, including Hindi, Kannada, and Bengali.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Shri in 2022, which is the fourth highest civilian award in India, for his contributions to the field of Art.
 
• Sonu Nigam has received numerous accolades for his singing, including National Film Awards, Filmfare Awards, and state awards.
 
• His versatile voice has made him one of the most popular and respected playback singers in the Indian music industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Awards:**

 
 
• The Padma Awards are one of the highest civilian honors in India, instituted in 1954. They are announced annually on Republic Day.
 
• The awards are given in three categories: Padma Vibhushan (for exceptional and distinguished service), Padma Bhushan (distinguished service of a high order), and Padma Shri (distinguished service).
 
 
 
• **Playback Singing:**
 
 
• Playback singing is the recording of songs by singers for use in films, where the actors lip-sync to the pre-recorded tracks.
 
• It is a common practice in Indian cinema, with playback singers often gaining significant popularity.
 
 
 
• **National Film Awards:**
 
 
• The National Film Awards is the most prominent film award ceremony in India, established in 1954. It is administered by the Directorate of Film Festivals, an organization set up by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.
 
• These awards aim to encourage the production of films of high aesthetic and technical standard and educational and cultural value.
 
 
 
• **Versatility in Singing:**
 
 
• Versatile singers, like Sonu Nigam, are known for their ability to sing in various genres and languages, showcasing their adaptability and talent.
 
• This versatility contributes significantly to their popularity and longevity in the music industry.
